subject: general
question: Who among the following Nobel Prize winners is the founder of a grassroots movement to combat deforestation?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Wangari Mathai**__.

__
 
• **Wangari Maathai was the founder of the Green Belt Movement and the 2004 Nobel Peace Prize, Laureate**.

 
 
• She authored four books: The Green Belt Movement; Unbowed: A Memoir; The Challenge for Africa; and Replenishing the Earth. 
 
• Peace on earth depends on our ability to secure our living environment.
 
• Maathai stands at the front of the fight to promote ecologically viable social, economic and cultural development in Kenya and in Africa.
 
• She has taken a holistic approach to sustainable development that embraces democracy, human rights and women’s rights in particular.
